title: pytest 9.1: fail the run when there are too many warnings
prompt:
Our CI should fail the test run when the suite emits more than 3 warnings, but the tests themselves must still pass: do not turn warnings into errors and do not edit the tests. The suite in tests/test_legacy.py currently emits 4 warnings. Add a pytest.ini that sets pytest's built-in limit for this (configuration only, no plugin and no conftest.py code).
Package versions in this environment are fixed: click 8.5.1, pytest 9.2.0, anyio 4.16.0.

source.note: Written by us for the Tavily on/off comparison; not from any public benchmark.
